subject: ui_copy: merge stored rows with defaults instead of discarding them
body: When a stored ui_copy (or any app_config key with required sub-keys) lacks keys added later, serve stored ∪ file-defaults (stored wins) instead of falling back to the whole file; log app_config_merged_defaults once; the admin GET shows which keys are defaulted; add a RUNBOOK line. db test: an admin-edited row saved before a new required key existed keeps its edit and gains the new key's default.
acceptance: Stored ui_copy rows missing newly required keys keep their admin edits; missing keys fill from config defaults; logged once; tests
